meta.title: Restraint Feng Shui studio
meta.description: Interactive Chinese metaphysics and Feng Shui studio supporting Bazi (Four Pillars), Qimen Dunjia, Meihua Yishu, Ziwei Doushu, and dual-chart synastry (Hepan), built on open-source lunar-javascript and iztro engines. Open the Restraint Studio tab from the right sidebar guide, use Beginner Guide for step-by-step tutorials and one-click demos, or chat with DeepSeek to cast charts visually and read active plugin chart data back for interpretation. All calculations run locally. Clicking “D老师解读” sends a prompt in the active conversation. Disabling the plugin removes the studio tab, slash command, and tools.
